Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned by the presenting party to the demand.

DemandAmount.name: Demand Amount
DemandAmount.definition: Details related to the demand amount.

AdvisingPartyReferenceNumber.name: Advising Party Reference Number
AdvisingPartyReferenceNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned by the advising party to the undertaking.

SecondAdvisingPartyReferenceNumber.name: Second Advising Party Reference Number
SecondAdvisingPartyReferenceNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned by the second advising party to the undertaking.

ConfirmerReferenceNumber.name: Confirmer Reference Number
ConfirmerReferenceNumber.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier assigned by the confirmer to the undertaking.

SettlementAccount.name: Settlement Account
SettlementAccount.definition: Details related to the settlement account.

PresentationDetails.name: Presentation Details
PresentationDetails.definition: Details of the beneficiary's presentation of documents.

RequestedExpiryDate.name: Requested Expiry Date
RequestedExpiryDate.definition: Requested new expiry date as an alternative to payment of the demand.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information related to the demand.

RequestedExpiryDate1Rule.definition: Requested expiry date must be present when demand type is Pay or Extend.

RequestedExpiryDate2Rule.definition: Requested expiry date may only be present when demand type is Pay or Extend.
